caption:
Not all screen time is the same. 📱⚽ Canada's guidelines give a simple daily balance for kids aged 5 to 17.

What's your family's best off-screen activity?

#ScreenTime #HealthyKids #ParentingTips #CanadianParents #ActiveKids

slides.title: At least 60 minutes of active play
items: Huffing and puffing counts: tag, biking, dancing, sledding.
It can add up through the day.

slides.title: No more than 2 hours of fun screen time
items: Shows, games and scrolling for fun.
Schoolwork and learning are separate from this limit.
slides.example: Example: a show after school and a family movie on Friday, plus lots of outside play.
